title: Egyptian Lentil Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with the flavors of Egypt. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Warm Egyptian Spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of paprika, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper

ingredients.name: Buttery Onions
ingredients.notes: Caramelized in butter until golden brown

ingredients.name: Lentils
ingredients.notes: Green or brown lentils work well

ingredients.name: Vegetable Broth
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium broth for a flavorful base

instructions: Cook the lentils according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, caramelize the onions in butter until golden brown.
Add the Egyptian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cooked lentils and cook for 5 minutes.
Roll out the casserole crust and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Fill the crust with the lentil mixture and top with feta cheese (if using).
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
